slot: Payments: merchant of record for software sales

pick.name: Paddle
pick.what: Merchant of record for SaaS and software
pick.why: Longest-established software MoR; handles tax calculation, collection, filing and remittance; credible with enterprise buyers
pick.free_limits: 5% + 50c per checkout transaction, no monthly fee; custom pricing for volume or sub-$10 products; supported seller countries and payout details not on page (unverified)

alts.name: Polar
alts.what: Developer-first merchant of record with licence keys, usage billing and an open-source platform
alts.why: Best developer experience and an open-source platform; licence keys, usage billing and paid tiers that undercut Paddle at volume
alts.free_limits: Starter 5% + 50c (no monthly fee); Pro $20/mo 3.8% + 40c; Growth $100/mo 3.6% + 35c; Scale $400/mo 3.4% + 30c; +1.5% non-US cards; $15 per dispute; Early Members (orgs before 2026-05-27) 4% + 40c + 0.5% subscriptions; Stripe payout fees $2/mo active + 0.25% + 25c per payout + 0.25-1% cross-border FX

alts.name: Dodo Payments
alts.what: Merchant of record with global cards/wallets, subscriptions, usage billing and licence keys
alts.why: Lowest headline MoR rate checked (4% + 40c) and onboards individuals without a company; younger company with inconsistent fee pages
alts.free_limits: 4% + 40c base (US cards); +1.5% non-US cards/APMs; +0.5% subscriptions/usage; +3% PayPal or BNPL; India domestic (INR cards+UPI) 4% + 15c (+intl fees where applicable); $1/refund; $30/dispute; payouts table says Free but FAQ says $5 if payout < $1,000; USD SWIFT $25

candidates.name: Paddle
candidates.verdict: PICK: mature MoR, 5% + 50c, tax filing included

candidates.name: Polar
candidates.verdict: Alt: best developer UX, open source, 3.4-5% + 30-50c by tier

candidates.name: Dodo Payments
candidates.verdict: Alt: low headline fees, India-native, young company, inconsistent fee pages

candidates.name: Lemon Squeezy
candidates.verdict: MoR at 5% + 50c; site banner announces Stripe Managed Payments transition; unclear for new builds

candidates.name: Stripe Managed Payments
candidates.verdict: Stripe's own MoR; see direct-processor slot

decision: A merchant of record (MoR) is the legal seller to your customers and handles VAT, sales tax, fraud and chargebacks, the lowest-effort path for a small team selling software globally. Paddle is the best overall: the longest-established software MoR, one all-in rate (5% + 50c) with no international-card surcharge listed, and credible with enterprise buyers. Choose Polar for developer experience and open source (cheaper than Paddle only on its paid Pro/Growth tiers at volume), and Stripe direct when you need full control, marketplaces or services billing and can handle tax registration.
details: Dodo payout-fee pages conflict (Free vs $5 under $1,000): unverified. No free option is recommended for this job.

region_notes.India: Stripe is invite-only for Indian businesses and India is not a Managed Payments business location; Paddle, Polar or Dodo (which also takes INR cards/UPI and pays out to Indian banks) are the practical routes, with Razorpay or Cashfree for domestic INR/UPI customers.
region_notes.US: MoRs remove sales-tax nexus tracking for the products they sell; you still handle your own income tax. Verify with a professional.
region_notes.EU: The MoR is the supplier of record, so you do not register for EU VAT (or the non-Union OSS) on sales it makes; the MoR pays you net. Verify with a professional.
region_notes.UK: The MoR accounts for UK VAT on its sales, so an overseas seller avoids UK VAT registration for those sales (GOV.UK: when a platform is responsible, it accounts for the VAT). Verify with a professional.

verify.note: Stress-tested vs Polar, Lemon Squeezy, Dodo: Paddle 5% + 50c, no monthly fee, tax filing/remittance, chargebacks and fraud included, no separate international-card surcharge listed. Polar Starter is the same 5% + 50c PLUS 1.5% on non-US cards, $15/dispute and Stripe payout fees ($2/mo active + 0.25% + 25c per payout + 0.25-1% FX), so Paddle is cheaper for global sales until Polar Pro/Growth tiers ($20-100/mo, 3.8%/3.6%) pay off at higher volume. Dodo 4% + 40c base but +1.5% non-US, +0.5% subscriptions, and its payout fee is contradictory (table 'Free' vs FAQ '$5 if payout < $1,000'). Lemon Squeezy is in transition to Stripe Managed Payments (Jan 2026 post: slower support, fewer updates) and should not be recommended for new builds. Paddle stays.
